mapper.select: select connection_id, voucher_id, start_time, end_time, is_use from voucher_connection where user_id=#{userId} order by connection_id desc limit #{start},#{need}

select connection_id, voucher_id, start_time, end_time, is_use from voucher_connection where user_id=#{userId} and start_time <= now() and end_time >= now() and is_use=false order by connection_id desc limit #{start},#{need}
select connection_id, voucher_id, user_id, promotion_id, order_id, start_time, end_time, create_time, is_lock, is_use from voucher_connection where connection_id=#{connectionId} and user_id=#{userId}
mapper.update: update voucher_connection set order_id=null,is_lock=false,is_use=false where order_id=#{orderId} and is_lock=true
update voucher_connection set is_use=true where order_id=#{orderId} and is_lock=true and is_use=false
mapper.select: select count(*) from voucher_connection where user_id=#{userId} and promotion_id=#{promotionId}

select discount_cost from merchant_voucher where voucher_id=(select voucher_id from voucher_connection where connection_id=#{connectionId} and user_id=#{userId} and is_lock=false and is_use=false) and start_time <= now() and end_time >= now() and min_cost <= #{cost}
mapper.update: update voucher_connection set is_lock=true,order_id=#{orderId} where connection_id=#{connectionId} and user_id=#{userId} and is_lock=false and is_use=false
mapper.select: select connection_id from voucher_connection where order_id=#{orderId}
